messages:
oliver: heads up — around 11:02 UTC we're seeing p99 latency jump from ~120ms to ~1.8s on the prod-serving pool. KV prefix cache hit-rate dropped from 92% -> ~3% in the same window :eyes:
maya: omg that drop is huge. any recent deploys or config changes?
devon: there was an autoscale + kernel-selection tweak rolled at 10:58 (deploy 9f3a2c). infra-bot shows a config change to `kv.max_shards` and `prefix_cache.eviction_policy` in the same release.
chen: grabbing flamegraphs and kv metrics now. initial flame shows a lot more time in kernel fallback loops; KV eviction rate spiked 10x. attaching quick snapshot: ``evictions/s: 2400 -> 24k`` ``cache_keys_active: 1.2M -> 300k``
infra-bot: deploy 9f3a2c by @devon — changed batch merge heuristic and bumped `kv.max_shards` to 64. Note: `prefix_cache.eviction_policy` defaulted to LRU->ApproxLRU via feature flag.
devon: that flag was to reduce memory churn during long sequences. didn't expect such catastrophic thrash. maybe ApproxLRU skewed to evict high-value prefix keys.
maya: could be noisy-tenant effect — autoscale created new shards, which redistributed prefixes and broke hot-key affinity. when ApproxLRU ran it may have evicted anchors. any tenant spikes in traffic?
chen: yep — telemetry shows tenant-7 had a bursty rerank job from 11:00–11:05 generating many long-prefix requests. Sequence length distribution shifted right. KV reuse dropped because prefixes moved across shards.
perf-bot: perf regression detected: p99 increase correlates with deploy 9f3a2c and feature flag rollout. Regression score: high.
oliver: mitigation plan: 1) flip prefix cache eviction policy back to LRU 2) rollback kernel-selection tweak (pin to kernels v2) 3) temporarily increase `kv.shard_affinity_window` to avoid immediate redistributed evictions
devon: starting rollback of the kernel-selection change now. rolling feature flag for ApproxLRU -> off (targeted rollout).
infra-bot: feature flag rollback initiated (ff:prefix-evict-approxlr).
chen: ran quick canary after flag rollback + affinity tweak: hit-rate climbed 3%->65% in 60s, p99 dropped to ~220ms. still not fully recovered to 92% but trending.
maya: good signal. do we need to pre-warm KV on shards or rebuild prefix index?
oliver: pre-warm might help. short-term: keep fallback policies pinned and add a throttling rule for tenant-7 rerank jobs. also add an alert for kv.hit_rate < 50% per-shard.
devon: throttling tenant-7 now and contacting customer to reschedule their rerank jobs. also opening a follow-up to add a test for ApproxLRU under hot-key skew.
chen: note for postmortem: root cause is combination of (a) kernel selection + autoscale changed shard mapping timing, (b) ApproxLRU policy evicted hot prefixes during redistribution, (c) a noisy tenant emitted long prefixes leading to low reuse. Action items: revert rollout gating, add regression test harness that simulates shard redistribution, add canary that checks per-tenant prefix hit-rate, and instrument shard-affinity metrics.
devon: holding rollback until we confirm steady metrics for 15m, will then do a full revert and ship a unit/regression test.
maya: thx all — please put notes in the incident tracker and tag eng-runtime postmortem. follow-up owner: @chen for tests, @devon for kernel pin/release, @oliver for alerts. :white_check_mark:
oliver: closing loop here — p99 normalized to ~130ms at 11:20 UTC after rollout revert + throttling. creating postmortem draft now.
